neighbours.label: the comma that closes a sentence-initial participial phrase naming who made, owned or named the subject ('Designed by X,', 'Called Y,'), just before the subject it describes, as against commas after clauses, adverbs, list items or relative clauses
fire: Built by the Roman army in 122 AD, the wall stretched across northern England.
Written by a young nurse during the war, the diary was published in 1952.
Owned by a retired dentist from Leeds, the boat is moored at the harbour.
Painted by an unknown Flemish artist, the portrait hangs in the main hall.
Called the Green Mile, the corridor led to the old execution room.
Produced by a small studio in Lyon, the film won three awards.
Commissioned by the city council, the statue was unveiled last May.
Named after a local saint, the church dates from the twelfth century.
